description: Self-hosted Renovate (proxmox-three platform/renovate, job mrm, daily 06:30 UK) - every update but majors automerges once CI passes; majors by hand (tcell v3 broke the build and was reverted, 2026-10-25); the Monday Release workflow ships what was merged

packageRules.description: majors by hand - a new major can build and still change behaviour (tcell v3 automerged and broke the build, reverted 2026-10-25)
one PR for Go module minor and patch updates - they all touch go.mod and go.sum; majors (new import paths) come one PR each
tcell stays on v2 until tview moves to v3 - tview's primitives take a tcell v2 Screen, so v3 does not build (reverted 2026-10-25)
